item.title: আবাসন নিরাপত্তা দারিদ্র্য হ্রাসে এবং জীবনমান উন্নয়নে ভূমিকা রাখে
item.description: দুর্বল ও অনিরাপদ বাসস্থান স্বল্প আয়ের মানুষের জন্য বড় ঝুঁকি তৈরি করে। প্রাকৃতিক দুর্যোগের কারণে ঘরবাড়ি ধ্বংস হলে তাদের সঞ্চয় নিঃশেষ হয়ে যায়। স্থায়ী ও নিরাপদ আবাসন দারিদ্র্য কমাতে এবং মানুষের মর্যাদা রক্ষায় সহায়তা করে।

item.title: Italian minister criticises Trump's Ukraine policy
item.description: Italy's Defence Minister Guido Crosetto told the BBC that US restrictions on aid to Ukraine are entirely incorrect. He warned that this approach could extend Russia's invasion instead of facilitating a resolution.

item.title: Trump asserts US Navy blockade halts Iranian vessels
item.description: US President Donald Trump stated that an ongoing US Navy blockade has successfully prevented any Iranian watercraft from navigating through the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Trump uses 'Mohammed' remark regarding Middle Eastern names
item.description: US President Donald Trump made a joke suggesting that people should simply use the name 'Mohammed' when uncertain about someone's name originating from the Middle East.

item.title: NH 66 toll collection halted at Nattika following protests
item.description: Authorities in Keralam have halted toll collection on National Highway 66 in Nattika. The decision follows public demonstrations and concerns over heavy traffic jams due to unfinished construction work.

item.title: CUSAT shifts to online classes due to chickenpox outbreak
item.description: Cochin University of Science and Technology suspended physical classes across its Thrikkakara and Marine campuses following an increase in chickenpox infections. Officials confirmed that affected students have departed the premises while academic activities moved online.

item.title: US removes restrictions on aviation companies from Mexico
item.description: The US Department of Transportation ended sanctions against Mexican airlines. This action came after Mexico implemented measures to resolve issues related to a bilateral aviation pact from 2015.

item.title: JNTU-GV enables quick online certificate delivery without fees
item.description: Vice-Chancellor V.V. Subba Rao announced that students can now obtain digital certificates rapidly without paying the previous three thousand rupee urgent fee. The update impacts roughly ninety thousand learners across thirty-seven institutions in six north Andhra regions.

item.title: Uttarakhand: Man detained for fatal assault over unpaid loan
item.description: Sunil Kumar was taken into custody for hitting Sumit Kumar from Bijnor with a bamboo pole. The fatal confrontation happened Thursday due to a disagreement over a 10,000 rupee debt.

item.title: Malkajgiri police arrest two for grabbing empty land with fake papers
item.description: Authorities detained two individuals involved in a scheme focusing on vacant estates. The syndicate used fraudulent paperwork by posing as original owners or rightful heirs.

item.title: Self-proclaimed mystic jailed after footage shows him tossing toddlers
item.description: Shrawan Mahto faced arrest after online footage captured him tossing small children around during a healing ceremony. Parents of the toddlers were present while the rituals took place.

item.title: CJP alleges Delhi law enforcement abducted activist Abhijeet Dipke
item.description: The CJP stated that Delhi law enforcement has detained Abhijeet Dipke against his will. The organization noted that more than ten hours have elapsed since the incident.

item.title: European Union dispatches diplomat to Beijing amid trade worries
item.description: The European bloc sent a representative to Beijing as surging Chinese shipments spark financial concerns. Officials view heavy manufacturing subsidies from China as a danger to local industries.

item.title: University invites Andhra Pradesh Governor for Ruby Jubilee event
item.description: Administrators briefed Governor S. Abdul Nazeer on the institution's four decades of history and invited him to the October 26 event. The Governor accepted the invitation to attend the celebration.

item.title: Donald Trump states Russian illness is likely not a biological weapon
item.description: Donald Trump remarked that officials do not believe the Russian disease is a bioweapon. Meanwhile, international bodies have called on Moscow for greater openness regarding the situation.

item.title: Kerala influencer investigated following allegations of child abuse
item.description: Law enforcement in Kerala registered a case against a female online creator for the alleged abuse of a young boy. Authorities have documented the victim's statement as the investigation continues.

item.title: YSRCP Requests All-Party Meeting Prior to Local Elections
item.description: The YSRCP has asked the State Election Commissioner to convene an all-party meeting. The party highlighted concerns regarding delayed caste certificates, requested Central security forces, and suggested voter lists be finalized after the SIR.

item.title: Police Chief Directs Enhanced Surveillance for Godavari Elections
item.description: DGP Harish Kumar Gupta instructed district superintendents in the Godavari region to utilize drones and strengthen intelligence networks. Authorities are directed to monitor sensitive areas closely and engage NCC and NSS volunteers.

item.title: Chennai Government College of Fine Arts Marks 175 Years
item.description: Established in the 19th century as the Madras School of Arts, the institution has shaped generations of artists. Leaders like Devi Prasad Roy Choudhury and KCS Paniker helped transform it into a center for modernist art and reform.

item.title: Three Fatalities Recorded After Tractor Strikes Crowd in Bijnor
item.description: A tractor plowed into a group of people in Uttar Pradesh, resulting in three deaths. Two victims died at a community health center, while a third passed away at a private hospital, according to local police.

item.title: Andhra Pradesh Proposes Japanese-Model Industrial Hubs for MSMEs
item.description: Industries Minister T.G. Bharath announced plans for industrial clusters to integrate MSMEs into global markets. The state currently has 714 planned projects valued at 22.6 lakh crore rupees, aiming to generate 1.93 million jobs.

item.title: Sharmila Extends Wedding Invitation to Tamil Nadu Chief Minister
item.description: Sharmila personally invited Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Vijay to attend her daughter's upcoming wedding ceremony.

item.title: Congress Alleges Voter Data App Linked to BJP Headquarters
item.description: Congress leader Jairam Ramesh posted evidence indicating security vulnerabilities in the Election Commission's voter portal and ECINet application. A researcher reportedly flagged these flaws to cybersecurity agencies in July.

item.title: Delhi Law Enforcement Urges Public to Avoid October 10 Rally
item.description: Delhi police have formally asked residents not to participate in the scheduled October 10 demonstration. Meanwhile, CJP leader Saurav Das criticized the restrictions, asserting that official pressure will not stop the protesters.

item.title: Kapil Sibal criticizes Prime Minister over electoral conduct
item.description: Kapil Sibal urged the Prime Minister to abandon animosity and prevent electoral fraud. This criticism followed the PM's event celebrating 25 years in office.

item.title: Anant Singh affirms unwavering allegiance to Nitish Kumar
item.description: Anant Singh stated his fidelity to Nitish Kumar is unquestionable. This declaration followed his decision to boycott JD(U) candidate Neera Kumar Singh in the Patna graduates’ constituency election.

item.title: RBI exempts individuals from fresh FEMA reporting rules
item.description: The Reserve Bank of India clarified that regular people are not subject to new FEMA reporting mandates. This update aims to reassure small digital operators and citizens handling permitted international transactions.

item.title: Artist Sri Kiruthika to lead Dindigul temple sketching workshop
item.description: Chennai creator Sri Kiruthika will demonstrate her techniques for illustrating temple architecture. The live drawing event is scheduled at the historic Dhadikombu Perumal Temple in Dindigul.

item.title: Veteran freedom fighter Socio Vasu passes away at 103
item.description: Fighter for independence 'Socio' Vasu died in Kerala at age 103. Post-independence, he engaged with the socialist faction, earning his affiliation from Jayaprakash Narayan.

item.title: Mirwaiz calls Shabir Shah bail rejection unjust and urges release
item.description: Mirwaiz labeled the denial of bail to Shabir Shah as disappointing and unfair, urging the Central government to facilitate his freedom. He also expressed worry regarding other detained politicians facing severe health problems.

item.title: Pope seen publicly following surgery and cancer diagnosis
item.description: The pontiff has been photographed for the first time since undergoing a medical procedure at Rome's Gemelli Hospital. Medical staff diagnosed him with lung cancer following the Tuesday surgery.

item.title: Ranabaali earns Rs 16.50 crore globally on opening day
item.description: The Rahul Sankrityan-directed movie Ranabaali, starring Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna, debuted in cinemas on October 16, 2026. It grossed Rs 16.50 crore worldwide on day one, including Rs 9.25 crore domestically.

item.title: Upcoming Ramayana movie unveils fresh action sequences
item.description: Newly released clips from Ramayana: Rise of a Legend showcase action moments with characters like Rama, Ravana, and Indra. The project stars Ranbir Kapoor, Kunal Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, and Yash.

item.title: Albanian Students Clash With Police Amid Ongoing Demonstrations
item.description: For four consecutive days, youth in Albania have demonstrated against government corruption and substandard campus facilities. Law enforcement and demonstrators engaged in clashes, with the nation's leader attributing the turmoil to external influence.

item.title: Apple Reveals Foldable iPhone Duo with Dual Screens and Touch ID
item.description: Apple has unveiled its anticipated foldable smartphone, featuring a 5.4-inch exterior screen and a 7.6-inch interior panel with a nano-texture coating and minimal crease. The device relies on Touch ID rather than Face ID for authentication.

item.title: Oregon Educator and Armed Father Intervene in School Shooting
item.description: Police report that a 16-year-old former student targeted a special education room at an elementary school. An educator confronted the suspect prior to an armed parent shooting the individual multiple times.

item.title: Hamburg Court Hears Child Abduction Trial of German Heiress
item.description: A high-security tribunal in Hamburg has spent 15 months processing the legal case against Christina Block. The restaurant chain heiress faces allegations of orchestrating the kidnapping of her own offspring.

item.title: ONS Reports Over One Million Non-Smokers Vaping in UK
item.description: Data from the Office for National Statistics indicates that more than one million individuals who previously avoided smoking have adopted e-cigarettes. This highlights a growing trend of nicotine consumption among lifetime non-smokers.

item.title: Anthropic Proposes AI Legislation Focused on High-Damage Thresholds
item.description: Reports indicate Anthropic has presented lawmakers with a draft safety bill. The legislation would empower authorities to block AI models only if they present a foreseeable, imminent threat causing severe casualties or massive financial damage.

item.title: Rajinikanth Starrer Jailer 2 Surpasses Rs 200 Crore Globally
item.description: The action film Jailer 2, featuring Rajinikanth alongside Mohanlal and Vidya Balan, achieved massive global earnings. Within two days of its theatrical debut, the movie crossed the Rs 200 crore milestone worldwide.

item.title: Reliance Industries Tells Elon Musk Market Rivalry Requires Compliance
item.description: Reliance Industries stated to Elon Musk that while market competition is embraced, adherence to local regulations remains mandatory. The remark outlines the corporate stance on regulatory compliance for incoming competitors.

item.description: As reported by Times of India, Zam-2.0: North Korea tests high-speed AI-guided torpedo. Key points: North Korea, north, korea, tests.

item.title: Italy probes Israel’s Katz over abuse, sexual assault of flotilla activists
item.description: As reported by Al Jazeera, Rome prosecutors also name 12 senior military, police and prison officials over alleged abuse of detained activists. Key points: Italy, Israel, Katz, Rome.

item.title: মুসলিম সমাজে মোনাফেক কারা, তারা কীভাবে কাজ করে
item.description: Prothom Alo-এর প্রতিবেদন অনুযায়ী, আরব মরুভূমির এক ছোট্ট ও চঞ্চল প্রাণী ‘জারবোয়া’। খুব বেশি লাফায় বলে একে অনেকে মরু ইঁদুর বা ক্যাঙ্গারি ইঁদুর বলে। আত্মরক্ষার প্রয়োজনে এই প্রাণীটির এক অদ্ভুত প্রবৃত্তি হয়, যা প্রাচীনকাল থেকেই আরবদের মনোযোগ আকর্ষণ করেছিল। জারবোয়া যখন মাটির নিচে নিজের থাকার জন্য গ…। এ ঘটনায় আলোচিত: জারবোয়া, ইঁদুর, মুসলিম, সমাজে।

item.title: Putin Agrees To Cooperate With Pope Leo's Plea For Aid For Ukrainian Town
item.description: As reported by NDTV, Pop Leo phoned Putin and asked him to arrange a ceasefire to let aid and food into the town, taken by Russian forces in February 2022, the Vatican stated. Key points: Putin Agrees To Cooperate With Pope Leo, Plea For Aid For Ukrainian Town Pop Leo, Putin, Russian.

item.title: Australian Suburbs See Mortgages Fall Below Rent Costs
item.description: Flat housing values and elevated rental expenses mean home loan repayments have become lower than monthly rent in multiple Australian neighborhoods.

item.title: Indiana Father And Daughter Rehabilitate Land For Rare Salamander
item.description: An agricultural property in Indiana has been rehabilitated by a father and his daughter. Their conservation efforts aim to safeguard a threatened salamander species.

item.title: Apple Updates App Store Policies To Prohibit AI Nudity Software
item.description: Apple has revised its App Store guidelines to explicitly prohibit applications that utilize artificial intelligence to generate non-consensual intimate photos. This policy update follows public backlash regarding similar tools on other platforms.

item.title: Pakistan School Roof Collapse Prompts Demands For Accountability
item.description: Relatives in Peshawar, Pakistan, are calling for justice following a structural failure at a local school. The collapse of the roof resulted in the deaths of 34 pupils.

item.title: North Korea Conducts Test Of New Artificial Intelligence Torpedo
item.description: State media reports that North Korea has tested a high-speed precision weapon utilizing artificial intelligence for guidance and target acquisition. The evaluation assessed propulsion systems refined through numerous trials conducted over the past half-decade.

item.title: Tehran rejects Riyadh's claims on Houthi strikes
item.description: Iran has formally rejected allegations from Saudi Arabia regarding its participation in recent attacks executed by Houthi forces.

item.title: Teenager Kills Four In US School Shooting Using Maternal Firearm
item.description: A 16-year-old opened fire at an American educational facility, resulting in four fatalities. The perpetrator used a firearm belonging to his mother and focused his attack on a special needs classroom.

item.title: James Cameron Acknowledges Avengers Endgame Reclaiming Box Office Record
item.description: Director James Cameron congratulated the filmmakers behind Avengers: Endgame after the movie surpassed Avatar to reclaim the top box office position. He posted themed artwork to mark the occasion, noting the achievement publicly for the second time.

item.title: Yemeni Authorities Report Missile Strikes on Aden Facility
item.description: Yemen's administration stated that Houthi rebels launched a pair of missiles targeting the airport in Aden. This incident coincides with governmental claims of military progress and hundreds of enemy casualties in Marib.

item.title: Amazon Deforestation In Brazil Falls To Near 40-Year Low
item.description: Data indicates that 3,335 square kilometers of the Brazilian Amazon were destroyed in the 12 months leading up to July. Officials noted this represents the lowest rate of forest loss recorded since 1988.

item.title: Football Rumors: Bellingham Extension and Transfer Interest
item.description: Reports indicate Real Madrid player Jude Bellingham is prepared to extend his stay with the Spanish team. Meanwhile, other clubs are monitoring transfer valuations and situations for players at Arsenal, Liverpool, Manchester United, Chelsea, and Barcelona.

item.title: Wrestler Natalie Eva Marie Completes Divorce From Jonathan Coyle
item.description: Professional wrestling personality Natalie Eva Marie has legally separated from Jonathan Coyle following a decade of marriage. She stated that the relationship ultimately functioned more like a commercial partnership.
